title: Strategic rules
description: Global strategic and campaign constants (spec STR, GEN-012..GEN-015, GEN-019). Per-terrain movement and visibility live in data/strategic-terrain.json (STR-095); battle duration is TAC-003 battleDurationHours in tactical-rules. Roads have no visibility of their own (STR-006).
$comment: Named constants. Fields are optional until the content pass fills them with the design drafts listed in the spec.

capitalBonusIncomeUsd.description: STR-007: the capital holder's bonus income per day, design draft 3000

victoryTileShare.description: share of all tiles a faction must control together with the capital, design draft 0.6

victoryHoldDays.description: days both must be held without a break, design draft 14

endlessWarDay.description: day on which the war locks into endlessWar if no one has won, design draft 120

cashOutFundsUsd.description: PMC money above which cash-out is offered, design draft 2000000

reformedCeasefireDays.description: GEN-019: days the general SSV–VDK ceasefire must hold, both exhausted, for the reformed ending, design draft 14

coup.description: GEN-013, GEN-015: player coup requirements and holding phase (exhaustedSigns is also the exhaustion test of GEN-019)

exhaustedSigns.description: GEN-013: crisis signs that make a faction exhausted, design draft 4

acceptDays.description: GEN-015: days held after the coup after which a patron accepts, design draft 30

krugEscortPrice.description: STR-094: price = (baseUsd + perTileUsd × route tiles) × dangerFactor when the route crosses the front or hostile ground

newFactionStartFundsUsd.description: STR-092: start funds of a resistance group or rogue PMC when it becomes a faction, design draft 20000

readyHours.description: hours before the new squad can act, design draft 12

startHour.description: STR-001, hour of Day 1, design default 6 (06:00)

factionTickOrder.description: STR-003, order in which factions act each hour

losing.description: STR-061 (owner; GEN-017 uses it): a faction is losing while it lost tiles on at least lossDaysMin of the last windowDays days

roadMoveHours.description: STR-006: hours per tile along a road (asphalt = dirt)

onFootHours.description: STR-006/STR-031: hours per tile on foot off-road. `default` for every passable terrain, plus an override per strategic-terrain ID (design: default 2, mountain 3)

offroadReduction.description: STR-032: per off-road rating, hours taken off strategic-terrain moveHours, per strategic-terrain ID (design: steppe and woods; not set)

fuelPerRegion.description: STR-032: fuel units per tile moved, flat for every terrain, spent on arrival (a cancelled or interrupted move spends none), design draft 1 (1 unit = one 20-litre fuel can)

heliMoveHours.description: STR-034, design 1 (single value for every helicopter)

pilotTechnicalMin.description: STR-034, design 50 (single value for every helicopter)

heliFire.description: STR-034: one roll per hostile military point of interest on the helicopter's path (POI types flagged military in data/poi.json, or a tile with a hostile squad), exclusive outcomes; damaged = must land and be repaired before flying on

heliFieldRepair.description: STR-034: field repair of a damaged grounded helicopter by its squad's best Technical soldier; hours = ceil(baseHours × baseTechnical / Technical)

baseHours.description: hours of work at baseTechnical, design draft 24

aiSoldiers.description: STR-017: per-soldier records of AI soldiers in the world slice

rankMix.description: Default rank → share for AI soldiers created without a rule's own mix (not set, STR Open questions 57)

contaminationHpPerHour.description: STR-097: HP lost per soldier per strategic hour on a contaminated or hazard tile, design draft 2

noiseRange.description: STR-008: notice range in tiles per vehicle noise class (design draft: low 1, medium 2, high 3, veryHigh 4, extreme 6)

supplyDeficitEffect.description: STR-014: how a supply deficit lowers squad supplies and reinforcement rate, not set

scoutSuccess.description: STR-036: scout success chance inputs, not set

actionHours.description: Duration in hours per strategic action (design drafts in the descriptions)

buyFob.description: STR-042: hours before a bought FOB can be used, design draft 24

payFaction.description: STR-043: pay compensation or pay off a bounty, design draft 0

krugEscort.description: STR-094: hire a Krug escort, design draft 0

brokerCeasefire.description: STR-099: broker the general SSV–VDK ceasefire at a governmental institution, design draft 24

evadeChance.description: STR-024: chance in percentage points = clamp(basePct + bestRecon / reconDivisor + visibilityBonusPct[class], minPct, maxPct)

visibilityBonusPct.description: terrain visibility class → bonus (design draft: low 20)

krugPassPricePerSoldierUsd.description: STR-025: price per soldier in the player's squad, design draft 100

autoResolve.description: STR-026: off-screen fight resolution (strength = soldiers × gear tier)

defenderTerrains.description: terrains where the defender factor applies (settlement tiles always), design draft woods, mountain

loserLoss.description: [min, max] share of soldiers lost, design draft [0.30, 0.60]

winnerLoss.description: [min, max] share of soldiers lost, design draft [0.10, 0.30]

shockRadius.description: STR-047: rank → region distance, or "all" (design: major 0, colonel 3, general all)

moraleLoss.description: STR-047: soldier rank → morale loss per soldier (design: elite 40, veteran 25, regular 10, recruit 5)

intelGoods.description: STR-048: VIP rank → barter goods value (design: major 1500, colonel 4000, general 10000, leader 25000)

intelPrice.description: STR-048: VIP rank → USD (design: major 2000, colonel 5000, general 12000, leader 30000)

intelStanding.description: STR-048: VIP rank → minimum reputation with the seller (design: 20, leader 50)

scatterShares.description: STR-049: shares of a dissolved faction's squads (not set)

relationMin.description: STR-051 (owner; GEN-007, SAI-003 point here), design -100

crisis.description: STR-069: thresholds for the ten crisis signs
